hooks.command: $raw = if ($env:CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT) { $env:CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT } elseif ([Console]::IsInputRedirected) { [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() }; if (-not $raw) { exit 0 }; $d = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = if ($d.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'tool_input') { $d.tool_input.file_path } else { $d.file_path }; $root = if ($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) { $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR } else { $PWD.Path }; $root = Join-Path $root ''; $py = Join-Path $root '.venv\Scripts\python.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $py)) { $py = 'python' }; if ($f -and $f.EndsWith('.py') -and $f.StartsWith($root, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { & $py -m black $f 2>&1; & $py -m isort $f 2>&1 }

$r = if ($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) { $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR } else { $PWD.Path }; try { & "$r\.claude\hooks\Assert-FileEncoding.ps1" } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("BLOQUEADO: Assert-FileEncoding.ps1 falhou antes de decidir: $_"); exit 2 }; if ($null -eq $LASTEXITCODE) { exit 2 }; exit $LASTEXITCODE

$raw = if ($env:CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT) { $env:CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT } elseif ([Console]::IsInputRedirected) { [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() }; if (-not $raw) { exit 0 }; $d = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = if ($d.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'tool_input') { $d.tool_input.file_path } else { $d.file_path }; if ($f -and $f -match 'Dashboard[/\\]src') { npm run lint:js 2>&1 }

$r = if ($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) { $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR } else { $PWD.Path }; try { & "$r\.claude\hooks\Register-GateRun.ps1" } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("BLOQUEADO: Register-GateRun.ps1 falhou antes de decidir: $_"); exit 2 }; if ($null -eq $LASTEXITCODE) { exit 2 }; exit $LASTEXITCODE

$r = if ($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) { $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR } else { $PWD.Path }; try { & "$r\.claude\hooks\Assert-StopQualityGate.ps1" } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("BLOQUEADO: Assert-StopQualityGate.ps1 falhou antes de decidir: $_"); exit 2 }; if ($null -eq $LASTEXITCODE) { exit 2 }; exit $LASTEXITCODE

$raw = if ($env:CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT) { $env:CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT } elseif ([Console]::IsInputRedirected) { [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() }; if (-not $raw) { exit 0 }; $d = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = if ($d.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'tool_input') { $d.tool_input.file_path } else { $d.file_path }; if (-not $f) { exit 0 }; $r = if ($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) { $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR } else { $PWD.Path }; try { Import-Module "$r\.claude\hooks\HookCommon.psm1" -Force -DisableNameChecking; $sensivel = Test-SensitiveTarget -Value $f } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("BLOQUEADO: guard de arquivos sensiveis falhou antes de decidir: $_"); exit 2 }; if ($sensivel) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("BLOQUEADO: arquivo sensivel nao pode ser editado pelo agente: $f"); exit 2 }; exit 0

$r = if ($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) { $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR } else { $PWD.Path }; try { & "$r\.claude\hooks\Assert-SensitiveWriteGuard.ps1" } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("BLOQUEADO: Assert-SensitiveWriteGuard.ps1 falhou antes de decidir: $_"); exit 2 }; if ($null -eq $LASTEXITCODE) { exit 2 }; exit $LASTEXITCODE
